title: Fold Points and Spatial Remnants
text: Excited Rough Spatial Crystal Blocks can be crafted into Spatial Fold Points. Analyze these points to obtain Space Microcores.
Folding checks a safe landing for the entire vehicle and passenger group and grants a brief arrival cooldown. Leaving the sphere interrupts charging.
Harvest a point with a Dissociation spell or a ritual sword's melee, charged slash or flying needle. It leaves an unbreakable Spatial Remnant. The harvested point item cannot be placed directly.
Reverse Time Flow and Spatial Blade also harvest both Time Warp Points and Spatial Fold Points on contact, without requiring Construction or any other spell element.
Move a Spatial Remnant with a Pocket Magic Bottle, or make a placeable remnant through advanced condensation.

A Spatial Remnant counts the distance all entities travel within a five-block sphere, including dropped items. After 100 blocks of movement in total, a Spatial Fold Point regrows in its place. Progress survives leaving the area, reloading the world and moving the remnant with a Pocket Magic Bottle.

A stack of 16 Spatial Fold Points collapses into an Unstable Spacetime Aggregate in the main inventory or ordinary storage. The hotbar is safe, and a Spacetime Stabilization Upgrade protects stacks inside an orb.
Sneak-right-click either block with an empty main hand to preview its 5-block effect radius.
